provenance.panel_a: Four completed independent searches through 100 mutations; arithmetic means and observed min--max range.
provenance.panel_b: Single selected best feasible shared protocol, compared with its unchanged iteration-0 baseline.
provenance.baseline_energy_semantics: Absolute compiled-unitary energy error in Hartree; measured iteration-0 result, not a calibration allocation.

reporting_cohort.rule: 4 declared independent searches with complete retained-policy coverage through round 100; iterations0 through100 inclusive.

selection.rule: 4 declared independent searches with complete retained-policy coverage through round 100; iterations0 through100 inclusive.

trajectory.semantics: Retained shared incumbents, including the unchanged iteration-0 baseline; no rejected-trial scatter or extrapolation. Individual Hamiltonians can regress after an aggregate improvement.
trajectory.averaging: Arithmetic mean of each Hamiltonian's own baseline-relative T95 across selected seeds, followed by an equal-weight Hamiltonian mean; this display is distinct from the geometric-mean acceptance objective.
trajectory.shading: Observed minimum-to-maximum of the selected seed-level Hamiltonian means at each round; not a confidence interval or standard deviation.
trajectory.energy_semantics: Absolute compiled-unitary energy error before averaging, in mHa. The baseline simulation budget is a fixed calibration reference; candidate QPE precision adapts to measured error.
